newsitem.title: USA: Compositech venture gets credit commitment.
newsitem.headline: Compositech venture gets credit commitment.

text.p: Compositech Ltd said on Monday its proposed Canadian joint venture had received a commitment for a $13.3 million credit facility from the National Bank of Canada.
The credit facility consists of a $9.8 million, seven-year term loan and a short term loan for $3.5 million to be used for working capital requirements, Compositech said.
The company plans to enter a joint venture with a Quebec investor group for the purpose of building a facility to make printed circuitry boards, Compositech said.
The credit will supplement about $11 million of investment from the joint venture partners, Compositech said.
The Montreal plant is expected to begin production next year and have an annual sales capacity of over $30 million.
